story.paragraph: We believe a restaurant is, above all, about teamwork. Our dining room, kitchen, and pizzeria work together every day with the same philosophy: to make every guest feel welcome, cared for, and completely at home.

owner.altOwner: Mattia Ambrosi, the heart behind Grano e Gusto
owner.paragraphBefore: At the heart of this journey is
owner.paragraphAfter1: , a young pizza chef who turned a passion discovered almost by chance into a profession built on dedication, continuous learning, and experience.
owner.paragraphAfter2: For Mattia, learning never stops: the more you grow and refine your skills, the better the food and the experience you can offer your guests.
